profile.headline: Software Engineer + Entrepreneur | Ex-AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer and technical lead specializing in large-scale distributed systems. I enjoy taking complex, often seemingly disconnected problems, and solving them with simple, holistic solutions. At AWS and Lockheed Martin Space, I’ve designed and built reliable, high-scale systems. These applications cover a broad range from powering the behind-the-scenes work of satellite assembly, to employee time-tracking, to securely storing data for enterprise companies 24/7 across the globe.  

I’ve always had a passion for building side-projects and more recently this evolved into my first entrepreneurial venture: a B2B SaaS platform in the influencer marketing space. While the business didn’t take off, it was an invaluable learning experience in market research, customer interviews and acquisition, and end-to-end SaaS strategy and execution.  

If you’re interested in distributed systems or early-stage ventures send me a note - I’d love to connect and chat.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Launched a B2B SaaS platform that helps influencer agencies and e-commerce brands streamline Shoppable TikTok campaigns by automating creative briefs and content scripts. Handled all aspects of the venture, from market research and early user acquisition to product design and engineering. Gained hands-on experience in end-to-end SaaS development, customer interviews, and launching a beta product from scratch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for AWS Data Lifecycle Manager’s internal auditing system. Drove an 18-month initiative across the full software development lifecycle to create a system that detects customer impacting bugs and automatically reports and resolves them.  

Designed and implemented several other components of public facing AWS launches including a time-spanning load balancer and a billing system for an AWS Backup feature released at re:Invent. I also enjoyed mentoring junior engineers and redefining knowledge sharing sessions to promote deeper understanding and stronger shared contextual knowledge across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · SQL · Cloud Computing · Data Lakes · Python · Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with a local MD to create an iOS app that helps medical professionals and students stay informed of the latest and most effective contraceptive methods. Implemented a simple and easy to use design so that the app can be used as a quick reference to maximize patient care. Contraception Point-of-Care was released on the iOS store in April 2017.

positions.title: Open Source Developer
positions.description: Created a GUI based application in C# to automate the tasks of creating, loading, and saving books in the Augmented Reality Magic Book (ARMB) in a team of two. Participated in weekly scrum meetings and helped with the design process.

projects.title: Drone Delivery System with Lockheed Martin
projects.description:
-Member of team designing a dual quadcopter system used to deliver payloads.  The targeting quadcopter will be remotely controlled while the delivery quadcopter will be fully autonomous
-Learned RTKLIB to achieve greater accuracy from standard GPS module.
-Programmed Raspberry Pi using Python

projects.title: Student Registration System Database
projects.description:
-Created entity-relationship diagram based on requirements of the system. 
-Transformed entity-relationship diagram to tables.
-Performed table normalization to assure all tables were in a minimum form of 3NF.  
-Implemented Student Registration System with GUI in Java and PL/SQL.
